actions.operation: Translate the geometric and arithmetic triples into $a_{2k}^2=a_{2k-1}a_{2k+1}$ and $2a_{2k+1}=a_{2k}+a_{2k+2}$, then derive $r_{k+1}=2-1/r_k$ for $r_k=a_{2k}/a_{2k-1}$.
Set $s_k=(r_k-1)^{-1}$, prove $s_{k+1}=s_k+1$, and derive $a_{2k-1}=C(m+k-1)^2$ and $a_{2k}=C(m+k-1)(m+k)$ with $C$ and $Cm$ positive integers.
Because $13=2k-1$, determine $k$ and substitute only into the odd-term formula $2016=C(m+k-1)^2$; set $d=Cm$, compare prime exponents in $(d+C(k-1))^2=2016C$, enforce $d>0$, and evaluate $a_1=d^2/C$.

strategies.plan: Linearize the ratio recurrence, derive the quadratic odd/even formulas, then use index $13=2k-1$ exclusively with the odd square constraint and integer prime-exponent comparison.
